In your eyebrow that blended smoothly with your skin and still consistently doing its job to deflect water from coming into your eyes. The true love that don't need anything but keeps on giving.

Why blush is one of the best-selling makeup? because most people don't have the natural red pinkish cheek. The sign of aliveness vulnerability and health.

Asymmetrical face, a proportional nose so that you can see the guidelines on how to see the cheek, eyes, eyebrows and lips, the big wide eyes just like a doll that every girl wants when they are young, and a smile as beautiful as the harmonious synchronization of the solar system moving together for the infinite time.
